finding: The motion control accessible label did not match its visible wording.
resolution: Use Motion on/off for both visible and accessible state; verify by role and keyboard.

finding: Initial mobile Lighthouse performance 59 exposed shader and scene startup costs.
resolution: Use simpler paper material, smaller texture, bounded demand rendering, font preload and critical CSS; remeasure.

finding: App Playwright reset test-results/ and erased earlier component receipts.
resolution: Write component receipts into qa-artifacts/storybook/, separate from the app test runner output.

finding: XY-only root scaling left hinge depth unscaled, projecting the opening above the header.
resolution: Tween numeric camera state and render uniform scale3d; assert panel bounds during actual intermediate unfolding.

finding: Active-card endpoint checks missed an associated clipped heading, inconsistent narrative order and orphaned closing text.
resolution: Model complete reading ideas in logical source order; mount the same nodes onto physical panels only for the tour; retain stable printed ink and verify all text plus independent intermediate frames.

finding: Nearest-anchor settling reversed user intent; stale focus and expiring held-touch ownership selected the wrong chapter on return. Fractional scroll alignment could select the preceding section.
resolution: Let deliberate direction own settling; separate reading gesture and focus ownership, retain touch through release/momentum, and sample inside the reading line. Reproduce with real Tab/wheel/native touch and waits beyond settling.
